description: The charge move is where hand-aiming at the range circle hurt most — the 2D6 roll is the whole budget and wasting half an inch loses the charge. Dragging a charging model past its roll must now hold it at the farthest point it can still reach. Part A (setting ON, the new default): a Warboss with a kept 12" roll is dragged 25" and the ghost must stop at 12.00" from the pickup point, with the hop cost inside the roll. Part B (setting OFF): the identical drag runs the full 25" and reads as over the roll. Part C: with the clamp back on, the over-range drop commits at the clamped distance and the model's recorded charge path stays inside the roll — it is not rejected for distance. Asserts against the controller's own accounting (_charge_move_cost_inches / _get_model_charge_accumulated), which is the same accounting _validate_charge_position judges the drop with.

steps.script:
# Park the target 7.5" of EDGE distance straight below the charger — inside the
# 12" declaration range, and far enough that a 7" charge move (set below) can be
# spent in full and still land inside 1" engagement range instead of overshooting
# into an overlap. Derived from the real base radii rather than hard-coded.
var wb = GameState.state.units["U_WARBOSS_B"].models[0]
var bc = GameState.state.units["U_BLADE_CHAMPION_A"].models[0]
var r1 = Measurement.base_radius_px(int(wb.get("base_mm", 32)))
var r2 = Measurement.base_radius_px(int(bc.get("base_mm", 32)))
var y = 1880.0 + r1 + r2 + Measurement.inches_to_px(7.5)
bc.merge({"position": {"x": 300.0, "y": y}, "rotation": 0.0}, true)
return "target at y=%.1f (edge gap 7.5\")" % y

# The fixture has this Warboss attached to a Boyz mob, and an attached
# CHARACTER charges as part of its bodyguard rather than on its own. Detach it
# so it is an independently chargeable unit — this test is about the drag
# clamp, not about attachment.
var ch = GameState.state.units["U_WARBOSS_B"]
var bg_id = str(ch.get("attached_to", ""))
ch["attached_to"] = null
if bg_id != "" and GameState.state.units.has(bg_id):
	var bg = GameState.state.units[bg_id]
	var lst: Array = bg.get("attachment_data", {}).get("attached_characters", [])
	lst.erase("U_WARBOSS_B")
return "detached from %s" % bg_id

# Pin the roll to 7" against the 7.5" gap. A 12" roll into a 7.5" gap CANNOT be
# spent in full — the model would run through the target — so the drop would be
# rejected on the engagement-range rule and tell us nothing about the distance
# clamp. 7" leaves the full roll usable, which is the case this test is about.
var cc = tree.root.get_node("Main").charge_controller
cc.charge_distance = 7
return cc.charge_distance

# Part A: clamp ON (the default) and frame the drag so the pickup point and
# the far cursor are both on screen.
SettingsService.set_drag_clamp_to_max_range(true)
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
m.view_zoom = 0.6
m.view_offset = Vector2(300.0 - 900.0 / 0.6, 1880.0 - 200.0 / 0.6)
m.update_view_transform()
return SettingsService.drag_clamp_to_max_range

# Part B: undo the staged charge move and repeat with the setting OFF.
var cc = tree.root.get_node("Main").charge_controller
if cc.has_method("_on_undo_last_charge_model"):
	cc._on_undo_last_charge_model()
SettingsService.set_drag_clamp_to_max_range(false)
return not SettingsService.drag_clamp_to_max_range

# Part D — the PAD is always clamped, setting or no setting. Turn the player
# preference OFF, make the pad the active device, and the gate must still be on.
# The gate is the ONLY pad-specific difference; the ray search itself is the same
# code the mouse parts above exercise.
SettingsService.set_drag_clamp_to_max_range(false)
var cc = tree.root.get_node("Main").charge_controller
return InputDeviceManager.is_pad_active() and cc.drag_clamp_active()

# ...and the clamp still holds an over-range point at the roll while the pad is
# active and the preference is off. Called directly rather than by injecting
# mouse motion, which would flip the active device back to mouse & keyboard.
var m = tree.root.get_node("Main")
var cc = m.charge_controller
var start = Vector2(300.0, 1880.0)
cc.dragging_model = GameState.state.units["U_WARBOSS_B"].models[0].duplicate(true)
cc.dragging_model["original_position"] = start
cc.dragging_model_source_unit_id = "U_WARBOSS_B"
var clamped = cc._clamp_charge_to_budget(Vector2(300.0, 2880.0), "m1")
var reach = Measurement.px_to_inches((clamped - start).length())
cc.dragging_model = null
m.set_meta("charge_pad_probe", "pad_active=%s setting=%s clamped_reach=%.3f\" roll=%d\"" % [str(InputDeviceManager.is_pad_active()), str(SettingsService.drag_clamp_to_max_range), reach, cc.charge_distance])
return abs(reach - float(cc.charge_distance)) <= 0.05
